about: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next EXL3 3.05bpw_h5_ng5 on one Arc Pro B70: experts in USM host RAM behind a device expert cache, n-gram table on NVMe (trellis-serve 13f7ac1)
setup: NEEDS: 1x Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB (the server takes the whole card: 31.85 GiB resident at peak, 9,000 expert slots = 15.61 GiB); 68 GB of free system RAM (measured peak 67.26 GB at load, 64.93 GB steady: 45.8 GB routed experts + 8 GB n-gram row cache in USM host memory + ~10.6 GB process RSS); 85.14 GB for the weights on a LOCAL NVMe SSD (the 32.6 GB n-gram table is random-read with O_DIRECT while serving; 29.5 GB were read during one full speed sweep). Text only (vision is a follow-up). Launch = trellis-serve xpu/scripts/serve_flashnext_b70.sh at 13f7ac1 with the X008 final settings plus --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder (not in the measured runs), on a bridge network with --shm-size 64g where the measured runs used --network host --ipc=host. Measured on B70 #0 (omarchy): prefill 4k 1,152-1,162 / 32k 836-837 tok/s, decode 35.3-35.4 @31 / 33.7 @32k tok/s, gate top-1 98.93 % / KL 0.00116. Known gap: rare single-position logit spikes in teacher-forced scoring on XPU (greedy output unaffected); EXL3_SYNC_LOGITS=1 needs trellis-serve 67437fb or later.
